messages:
rachel: Noticing weird pctl behavior: endpoint detail shows p50 > p95 for one-minute buckets on /v1/completions. Happening intermittently this morning.

omar: That usually means two different sources are being compared (eg ingress vs merged). Do we have an example minute?

rachel: 2025-01-12T09:34Z. detail p50=320ms, overview p95=280ms. Screenshot uploaded.

jin: Quick check: our console pulls p50 from histogram_shards and p95 from tdigest_merged. The merge job had a ~40s delay during that minute because of GC churn. Ingress samples show a short-lived heavier tail that the merged row missed until the next merge window.

omar: So root cause = asynchronous merge + different source selection. UX confusion.

rachel: Proposal: make metric tiles explicit about source and add a per-tenant default. Default should be "canonical_post_routing" for SLOs, with an "early_detect" option showing ingress samples.

jin: Backend follow-up: add query param `source=ingress|post_routing` to metrics API and expose counts_by_origin in response. Frontend: badge + small legend (dashed orange = ingress).

umar: Also add a guardrail test: for any single-source query assert p50 <= p95 (monotonicity) in unit tests; alert if inversion found in prod telemetry (toggle off by default).

ui-bot: PRs created: frontend console UI: https://git.redwood/console/pulls/3701; infra metrics API: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/9221

rachel: Great. Can we also include the SQL used in an "explain" modal for advanced users? That helps debugging.

jin: Yep adding that to the PR.

omar: I'll add a tiny runbook blurb: "If overview vs detail disagree: check metric source badge and counts_by_origin. If ingress > 10% of samples, expect earlier anomalies."

rachel: Thanks team. Let's monitor and close the loop next week. :+1:
